name: limits
description: Shows your 5h and 7d limits, and stops deep research from running on expensive models unless your 5h window is about to reset and your weekly usage is low.

models.title: Models to watch
models.description: Which models get the deep research check, comma separated: fable, opus.

resetWithinMinutes.title: Let deep research run when the 5h window resets within (minutes)
resetWithinMinutes.description: Deep research on a watched model runs without asking only if your 5h window resets in less than this many minutes, and your weekly usage is under the limit below.

weeklyMaxPercent.title: Let deep research run while weekly usage is under (%)
weeklyMaxPercent.description: Deep research on a watched model runs without asking only if your weekly (7d) usage is under this percentage, and the 5h reset condition above holds.

openOnStart.title: Open the limits panel when a session starts
openOnStart.description: Shows the settings pane with your limits as soon as a session starts.
